description: React component for managing and displaying a permissions tree in the Mattermost admin console, including dynamic group updates based on license and config, and rendering permission groups.

classes.name: PermissionsTree
classes.description: React component class for permissions management in the admin console.

methods.name: updateGroups
methods.description: Updates permission groups based on current config, license, scope, and role.

methods.name: openPostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Opens the modal to edit post time limits.

methods.name: closePostTimeLimitModal
methods.description: Closes the post time limit modal.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: React lifecycle method to update groups when props change.

methods.name: toggleGroup
methods.description: Handles toggling of permission groups, invoking onToggle callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the permissions tree UI including permission groups and modals.
